purpose: Preregister a replay-owned evaluation of whether evidence-gated cognitive-loop adaptation improves held-out task outcomes and safely recovers from harmful interventions.
claim_guards: Detector accuracy is not evidence of adaptation utility.
An arm-reported stream digest is not proof that a shared replay actually delivered the same exogenous events.
A confirmatory adaptation score must bind to a raw replay receipt that the scorer revalidates; digest linkage is not proof of honest runner execution.
Oracle-timed adaptation is diagnostic only and is never a deployable comparator.
Passing coverage gates is not evidence of state-of-the-art superiority.
Synthetic fixtures validate execution contracts, not scientific hypotheses.
Never report one weighted aggregate unless its units and cost conversions were preregistered.

minimum_coverage.coverage_interpretation: For a complete dataset × seed × drift-cell factorial design this is 2800 dataset-seed-cell panels; any incomplete panel must list missing cells and cannot pass the complete-coverage gate.
minimum_coverage.tuning: Leave-one-dataset-out; tune on training datasets only and freeze before held-out evaluation.

access_tracks.allowed_signal: Valid prequential prediction error with explicit invalid/missing evidence semantics
Current features and registered calibration history available by decision time
Registered auxiliary/self-supervised loss with explicit availability timestamp
Observed outcomes only after the registered reveal delay
Ground-truth shift timing for offline upper-bound diagnostics

policy_arms.role: adapt at preregistered boundaries, not oracle timing
adapt only when registered expected-benefit and risk conditions pass
snapshot, shadow/canary, verify, commit or roll back

score_receipt_binding.executed_replay_outcomes: Every arm decision must carry finite non-negative task_loss and adaptation_cost_units plus task_loss_available_at_tick >= decision_tick.
score_receipt_binding.utility_schema_note: Counterfactual utility schema v3 adds task_loss_available_at_tick to each scored observation; receipt-bound scoring requires an exact match to the raw receipt decision record.
required_identity_matches: each of the five score arm repository_head_sha values equals the corresponding receipt arm
each of the five score arm configuration_digest values equals the corresponding receipt arm
for run_kind=replay, every per-cycle task_loss, adaptation_cost_units, and task_loss_available_at_tick value equals the corresponding receipt decision record
each score arm cycle panel exactly matches the receipt stream length and decision ticks
task_loss_available_at_tick must not precede its decision tick
score_receipt_binding.confirmatory_rule: compare-cognitive-adaptation-panel emits primary_comparison only when all 2800 expected cells exist and every scored record has receipt-link fields with source_replay_run_kind=replay; synthetic-not-measured records suppress the comparison
score_receipt_binding.limitation: The scorer validates raw schema-v2 receipts and joins the scored per-cycle loss/cost values to receipt decision records. The panel validates score digests and declared receipt linkage but does not independently re-read raw receipts or re-execute the replay driver. Neither step proves honest runner execution or effective oracle sandboxing; retain raw receipts and independently audit the runner.

replay_fail_closed_conditions: Missing, duplicated, reordered, early, or altered exogenous event
Any deployable arm can access oracle-only fields
Decision consumes evidence with availability_time after decision_time
Invalid evidence causes a forbidden state update or replay admission
Arm event ledger differs from the replay driver's canonical event ledger
Missing code revision, configuration digest, dataset digest, or required raw trace
Unexplained missing cycle or non-contiguous cycle index
Cost or outcome record cannot be reconciled with the event/action ledger

hard_gates.acceptance: Zero forbidden updates or replay admissions caused by invalid evidence in the registered hard-gate cases.
All arms consume the driver-defined exogenous event sequence in order, with identical event identities and availability times; policy states may diverge.
Zero oracle leakage or future-availability features used by deployable arms.
Every registered harmful intervention is rejected before commit or rolled back within a preregistered bound.
All required dataset × seed × scenario cells are present or explicitly fail the gate; no missing cell is imputed as a success.

statistical_protocol.primary_comparison: Paired policy difference in held-out task loss, detector-benefit-gated and staged-verify-rollback versus detector-triggered.
statistical_protocol.generalization: Publish every dataset-level effect and leave-one-dataset-out sensitivity; do not imply that an interval alone proves broad generalization.
statistical_protocol.uncertainty: Report paired uncertainty with dataset clustering, the registered hierarchical bootstrap, per-dataset signs, and raw per-seed results.
negative_controls: one-arm event mutation and event reordering
statistical_protocol.reporting: Keep detector metrics, task outcomes, decisions, safety/integrity, and resource costs separate. Preserve all failures and exclusions.

status_note: This is a proposed protocol, not an implementation, test result, or performance claim. The replay driver, adapters, and experimental runs remain future work.

confirmatory_inference.primary_estimand: Dataset-macro paired effect on post-shift task loss in the held-out dataset.
confirmatory_inference.selection_rule: Freeze the primary policy, metric, direction, and interpretation rule before examining held-out outcomes.
confirmatory_inference.multiple_comparisons: All other detector, policy, metric, and scenario comparisons are exploratory unless a comparison family and multiplicity-control procedure are preregistered before evaluation.
confirmatory_inference.prohibition: Do not select the best result from many detector/metric/scenario combinations and report its unadjusted interval as confirmatory evidence.
reporting: Report effect size and paired uncertainty, all per-dataset effects, and leave-one-dataset-out sensitivity.
Report the number of exploratory comparisons and any multiplicity-control procedure used.
A coverage pass, positive unadjusted interval, or single-dataset win is not proof of broad SOTA superiority.

cycle_windows.constraints: Each window must be non-empty and within the common cycle panel; pre-shift end must not exceed post-shift start.

recovery.success: First post-shift cycle beginning a run of the registered number of consecutive task-loss observations at or below threshold.
recovery.censored: If no qualifying run occurs within the post-shift window, recovery_cycle and recovery_delay_cycles are null.
recovery.area_metric_interpretation: Discrete per-cycle sum of positive excess loss above recovery_loss_threshold; all stream ticks have equal weight in this scorer.

counterfactual_metric_schema.claim_guard: These v2 phase-specific metrics are computed from supplied per-cycle arm summaries. They do not establish causal replay execution or validate outcomes independently.
required_input_validation: All five arms pin a version, repository revision, configuration digest, and the shared exogenous stream digest.
Every arm contains the same contiguous cycle panel.
No-adapt has zero adaptation cost at every cycle.
All evaluation windows and recovery criteria are validated before scoring.

information_access.rule: Each scored five-arm panel declares exactly one track. Never pool or directly compare scores from different access tracks in one confirmatory effect.

integrity_checks: Recompute every scored-record result_sha256 before using its values.
Require matching comparison_track, metric ID, and loss unit across all records.
Require the same source revision and version for each policy arm across the panel.
Permit per-dataset tuned configuration digests but require configuration stability across seeds/scenarios within each dataset.
Recompute the staged-versus-detector post-shift effect from the arm outcomes.
Require stream_id uniqueness across distinct dataset × seed × scenario cells.
panel_aggregation.incomplete_panel_behavior: List missing dataset × seed × scenario cells, set complete_coverage_gate_pass=false, and emit primary_comparison=null. Do not calculate or display a confirmatory effect/interval for incomplete coverage.
panel_aggregation.complete_panel_behavior: Call the existing hierarchical paired bootstrap with dataset resampling first, then seed resampling while preserving each seed's scenario block. Orient lower post-shift task loss as positive effect for the staged candidate.
panel_aggregation.caveat: This aggregates scored summaries and verifies their declared integrity; it does not prove the underlying replay ran honestly or that summaries came from causal execution.

required_checks: Verify raw protocol and panel bytes against the manifest SHA-256 digests.
Require exactly one bundle cell for every registered panel score.
Resolve all artifact paths under the canonical bundle root; reject absolute paths, traversal, and external symlinks.
Reject reused cell identities, scoring inputs, replay receipt bytes, and run IDs.
Recompute every utility score from the raw scoring input and receipt and require exact equality with the panel score.
Require every confirmatory cell to use run_kind=replay.
Recompute the complete panel comparison after all cells pass.
Require the bundle's raw-byte SHA-256 to match a separately supplied expected digest from an independent preregistration record.
independent_audit.preregistration: Publish the bundle-manifest SHA-256 in an independent timestamped preregistration record before inspecting held-out outcomes; pass it through --expected-bundle-sha256. A bundle hash stored only inside the bundle is not an independent pin.
independent_audit.limitation: Artifact audit does not prove honest runner execution, effective oracle sandboxing, dataset representativeness, or deployment superiority.
